reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Certain invalid CiliumNetworkPolicies that have always been ignored will now be rejected by the apiserver", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: resource-rejected

consequence.statement: CiliumNetworkPolicies with multiple L7 protocols on the same port, over 40 port rules, or over 40 ICMP rules, previously ignored, are now rejected by the apiserver.
consequence.remediation: Fix or remove such invalid CiliumNetworkPolicies before applying them.

proposed.statement: Invalid CiliumNetworkPolicies (multiple L7 protocols on the same port, over 40 port rules, or over 40 ICMP rules) that were previously ignored are now rejected by the apiserver via server-side validation.
